title: A part sale invoiced with Unassigned is credited to Unassigned
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have two active staff members at the test location with their "Sales Representative" switch on: sales rep A and sales rep B.
  • Use a customer with "Sales Representative - Service Labor" set to sales rep A, "Sales Representative - Service Parts" set to sales rep B and "Sales Representative - Part Sales" reading "Unassigned".
  • Have a part sale for that customer that starts with Sales Representative "Unassigned", with one part, and invoice it today without picking a representative.
  • Open Reports > Sales By Representative in a desktop browser at least 1024 pixels wide, with the date range set to today, Show Unassigned on and the Sales Type column turned on.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The whole of the part sale is credited to Unassigned, as one "Part Sales" row.
  • Sales rep A and sales rep B are not credited with it.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11268 (Story 4, Give a customer default representatives), story SV-11269 (Story 5, Credit each side on the invoice and in Sales By Representative)

  • S4-R18: “A part sale invoiced with no representative is credited, for the whole sale, to the person new part sales get from the customer (S4-R26), or to nobody when the Part Sales field reads "Unassigned".”
  • S5-R9: “A part sale is one "Part Sales" row holding every dollar of the invoice.”
